# datadog_action_execution_policy_v2 (Resource)

Provides a Datadog execution policy resource generated from the API specification.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "datadog_action_execution_policy_v2" "example" {
  name   = "Deny maintenance scripts"
  effect = "deny"
  action_pattern = {
    integration = "INTEGRATION_SCRIPT"
    action_fqns = ["*"]
  }
  scope = {
    scripts = {
      rules = [{ target_script_names = ["maintenance"] }]
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action_pattern` (Attributes) The set of actions this policy applies to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--action_pattern))
- `effect` (String) Whether the policy allows or denies matching actions. Valid values are `allow`, `deny`.
- `name` (String) The name of the execution policy.

### Optional

- `scope` (Attributes) Restricts where the policy applies. At most one scope type can be set,
and it must match the action pattern's integration. An empty object means
the policy has no scope restriction. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scope))
- `targets` (Attributes List) The targets this policy applies to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--targets))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `version` (Number) The version of the execution policy. Incremented on every update.

<a id="nestedatt--action_pattern"></a>
### Nested Schema for `action_pattern`

Required:

- `action_fqns` (List of String) The fully qualified action names this policy matches. Use `*` to match all actions
of the integration, or a fully qualified name prefixed with the integration's action
namespace (for example `com.datadoghq.script.*` for the Script integration).
- `integration` (String) The integration the action pattern applies to. Valid values are `INTEGRATION_KUBERNETES`, `INTEGRATION_REMOTE_ACTION`, `INTEGRATION_SCRIPT`, `INTEGRATION_SLACK`.


<a id="nestedatt--scope"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scope`

Optional:

- `kubernetes` (Attributes) Restricts the policy to specific Kubernetes namespaces. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scope--kubernetes))
- `remote_action_rshell` (Attributes) Restricts the policy to specific remote shell paths. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scope--remote_action_rshell))
- `scripts` (Attributes) Restricts the policy to specific scripts. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scope--scripts))
- `slack` (Attributes) Restricts the policy to specific Slack private channel names. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scope--slack))

<a id="nestedatt--scope--kubernetes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scope.kubernetes`

Required:

- `rules` (Attributes List) The Kubernetes scope rules. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scope--kubernetes--rules))

<a id="nestedatt--scope--kubernetes--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scope.kubernetes.rules`

Required:

- `target_namespaces` (List of String) The Kubernetes namespaces this rule applies to.



<a id="nestedatt--scope--remote_action_rshell"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scope.remote_action_rshell`

Required:

- `rules` (Attributes List) The remote shell scope rules. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scope--remote_action_rshell--rules))

<a id="nestedatt--scope--remote_action_rshell--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scope.remote_action_rshell.rules`

Required:

- `access` (String) The level of remote shell access granted for the target paths. Valid values are `read_only`, `read_write`.
- `target_paths` (List of String) The file system paths this rule applies to.



<a id="nestedatt--scope--scripts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scope.scripts`

Required:

- `rules` (Attributes List) The script scope rules. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scope--scripts--rules))

<a id="nestedatt--scope--scripts--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scope.scripts.rules`

Required:

- `target_script_names` (List of String) The script names this rule applies to.



<a id="nestedatt--scope--slack"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scope.slack`

Required:

<a id="nestedatt--scope--slack--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scope.slack.rules`

Required:

- `channel_name_selectors` (List of String) The private channel name selectors this rule applies to. Selectors are lowercase private channel names
without the leading `#`, and can contain `*` wildcards. Use `*` alone to match any private channel name.
